plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to reduce broad index concentration and free up capital.

conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions, holding a larger cash buffer.

This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It trims concentrated and leveraged positions while adding a quality name, maintaining a moderate cash buffer.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, accepting higher potential drawdowns. It increases leveraged ETFs and concentrates in strong performers, with a smaller cash buffer. Daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs can impact returns.

plan: Sell all SOXL, SPAL, SMH, and CRWD to exit leveraged and high-beta positions.
Add significantly to QQQI to maximize income generation.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month, prioritizing steady distributions and low drawdown. It shifts capital from growth and leveraged assets into income-generating ETFs like QQQI, with a significant cash buffer.
